visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blue cartoon character known as Bugcat Capoo appears on a stark white background, holding a white tray containing a burger, a red cup of soda with a straw, a red box of french fries, and a hotdog. The character has a happy expression with its eyes closed in delight and tiny paws gripping the tray edges. (2) Capoo picks up the hotdog and takes a bite, but the sausage inside slides out and falls onto the white table surface. The character's eyes widen in shock as a black question mark icon appears above its head. It then proceeds to stuff a whole burger into its mouth and drinks from the soda cup. (3) While drinking, dark liquid splashes onto the table from the cup. Capoo then picks up a fry, only to see a brown bug crawl out from the red fry container. The character begins to cry hysterically, with thick streams of white tears pouring from its eyes and an exclamation mark flashing briefly. (4) A yellow dog wearing a white chef's hat enters the frame and consumes the spilled food and the bug. It then magically transforms its body into a flat-topped table carrying fresh food. Capoo smiles with big, sparkling eyes, hugs the dog's face, and munches on a large bone-shaped bread piece.
